title: Slimline credential lifecycle and compact stream operator (py/ts/go) - ergonomic parity + version bumps
author: Priya Nair
description: Unify credential lifecycle signals and introduce a compact stream operator across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs to improve long-lived stream ergonomics and reduce auth-related flakiness. This PR standardizes auth TTL handling and backoff presets, exposes a lightweight 'compact' stream operator that minimizes per-event metadata for high-throughput streaming use-cases, and adds an explicit 'credential priming' step to reduce first-request latencies on delegated refresh flows. Changes include small API surface adjustments (minor helper names), cross-SDK retry template alignment, tests (unit + integration), examples updates, and version bumps to py-sdk v0.23.0 / ts-sdk v1.12.0 / go-sdk v1.5.3. Motivation: multi-language clients saw divergent behaviors when streams endured credential rotations or when consumers did many small concatenated streams; this converges behavior, improves telemetry labels, and provides a low-overhead streaming primitive for embedded agents. Checklist: [x] design doc linked, [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests in harness, [x] changelogs, [x] compatibility notes, [x] version bump. See commits for incremental work and CI results in the checks section.
